record.paper_title: Stability of Homomorphisms, Coverings and Cocycles II: Examples, Applications and Open Problems
record.original_question: Does there exist an infinite family of connected finite polygonal complexes {Xm} whose vertex degrees are uniformly bounded and for which both the 0-dimensional and 1-dimensional coboundary Cheeger constants with permutation coefficients are bounded below by the same positive constant λ, that is, h0^B(Xm, Sym) and h1^B(Xm, Sym) are at least λ for all m?

evidence.quote:
Problem 6.5 (Bounded coboundary expanders in permutations). Is there such a family for which
∀m ∈ N : hB0(Xm, Sym), hB1(Xm, Sym) ≥ λ,
for some λ > 0 independent of m?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a finite 2-dimensional polygonal complex, i.e. a connected CW complex whose 2-cells are attached along simple cycles of length at least 3 in its 1-skeleton. Write X(i) for the set of i-cells (i = 0,1,2). For a finite symmetric group Sym(n), equipped with the normalized Hamming distance d(σ,τ) = (1/n)|{j : σ(j) ≠ τ(j)}|, define i-cochains with permutation coefficients as functions α : X(i) → Sym(n), and define the coboundary δ in the usual nonabelian (permutation) sense, namely (δα)(σ) at an (i+1)-cell σ is the alternating product of α evaluated on its i-faces (using the local orientation conventions of polygonal complexes), regarded as zero when this alternating product is the identity. Define the normalized weight |α| of an i-cochain α to be the (normalized) sum over i-cells s of d(α(s), id), and similarly for (i+1)-cochains. The i-dimensional coboundary Cheeger constant with permutation coefficients is

  h^B_i(X, Sym) := inf_n inf_{α : X(i) → Sym(n), α ∉ B^i} |δα| / d(α, B^i),

where B^i denotes the set of i-coboundaries and d(α, B^i) is the normalized Hamming distance from α to the nearest coboundary.

Question: Does there exist an infinite family {X_m}_{m∈ℕ} of connected finite 2-dimensional polygonal complexes with uniformly bounded vertex degrees and a constant λ > 0, independent of m, such that

  h^B_0(X_m, Sym) ≥ λ and h^B_1(X_m, Sym) ≥ λ for every m ∈ ℕ?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is explicitly posed as an open problem on bounded coboundary expanders with permutation coefficients. Related work has resolved the F₂-coefficient case and exhibited examples (complete complexes, spherical buildings, coset complexes) of coboundary expanders with permutation coefficients, but no infinite family of bounded-degree polygonal complexes simultaneously expanding in both dimensions 0 and 1 with permutation coefficients has been published as of the current date.

status_evidence.title: Stability of Homomorphisms, Coverings and Cocycles II
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems including bounded coboundary expanders in permutations.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Coboundary expansion of coset complexes
status_evidence.snippet: Coset complexes are coboundary expanders over the symmetric group.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work studies permutation-coefficient expansion but does not resolve the bounded-degree two-dimensional case in both 0 and 1 dimensions.
